ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MuW uses your location to draw routes near you and to record your activities. During an activity it keeps recording with the phone locked, and iOS shows the blue bar.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MuW never records sound: during your activity it only speaks the directions.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: MuW saves your finished activities to Apple Health, with their time, distance, route and, for runs, estimated calories, so they also appear in the Fitness app.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: MuW reads your heart rate from Apple Health during each activity, to show it with the activity and in your post. You can hide it before you publish.
